scripts.build: next build && wrangler pages functions build --build-output-directory=out --outdir=.worker-build
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute spy-words --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute spy-words --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute spy-words --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute spy-words --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute spy-words --local --file=./reset.sql && npm run db:local
scripts.db:reset:remote: wrangler d1 execute spy-words --remote --file=./reset.sql && npm run db:remote
